violation_type.title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §744.2401(b))
violation_type.short_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns
violation_type.typical_finding: Snack time was observed, and they served only one component (grains). The operation is required to offer two components for snacks.

finding_variants.text: Snack time was observed, and they served only one component (grains). The operation is required to offer two components for snacks.

The operation's snack that was served during inspection did not follow the meals and snacks patterns established by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) that is administered by the Texas Department of Agriculture.
Children were served one component for the snack.
The operation's posted snack menu does not meet the snack patterns established by the USDA Child and Adult Care Food Program.

During the follow-up inspection it was found that the operation is not following the meal patterns established by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) that is administered by the Texas Department of Agriculture. Operations must follow this pattern regardless of whether or not they are participating in a food program for reimbursement.
It was observed that the operation served oreo cookies during snack time.
